The blue graphics and any potential text on the front of the diaper are slightly blurry and lack sharp edges. While not gibberish, they don't resolve into clear brand logos or distinct shapes, typical of AI struggling with small print on curved surfaces.
The forearm and wrist area appear slightly elongated and the connection to the hand is somewhat ambiguous due to the angle and lighting, but not severely distorted.
